newsitem.title: USA: Individual Inc target of securities suit.
newsitem.headline: Individual Inc target of securities suit.

text.p: Individual Inc said Friday that it, its former chief executive and certain officers and directors had been named as defendants in a purported class-action securities lawsuit.

The suit accuses the defendants of having made misstatements or having failed to make statements in the company's March 1996 initial public offering prospectus about alleged disputes between Individual Inc and former Chief Executive Joseph Amram.
"The company believes the allegations in the complaint are without any merit and intends to vigorously defend against them," Individual Chairman William Devereaux said in a statement.
Amram, who founded the company, resigned in August after going on a leave of absence in July. At the time, he said he would fight to regain the CEO post.
Several weeks after his resignation, Individual Inc said it was seeking a continued role for Amram.
The lawsuit was filed on behalf of stockholders who bought stock between March 15 and July 24.
Amram was succeeded by Michael Kolowich as president and chief executive.
Individual Inc provides electronic personalized information services.
